subject.title: fix: allow bailian provider in resolveThinkingProfile

question: Should core explicitly treat custom provider ID `bailian` as Qwen-thinking-compatible when its model row opts into `compat.thinkingFormat`, while leaving official Bailian catalog and onboarding work outside this PR?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and has real-run evidence, but the linked issue requests broader first-class provider support, so only maintainers can define whether this core allowlist is the intended long-term support boundary.

options.title: Approve the narrow custom-provider contract
options.body: Keep the two inference changes, update the issue reference to non-closing context, and leave official catalog/onboarding scope in the linked issue.

options.title: Keep inference provider-neutral
options.body: Replace the explicit provider allowlist with a generic configured-model compatibility rule only if maintainers want every explicitly opted-in OpenAI-compatible Qwen backend to receive this behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow custom-provider contract
recommendation.body: Keep the two inference changes, update the issue reference to non-closing context, and leave official catalog/onboarding scope in the linked issue.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the prior merged configured-Qwen compatibility surface most directly related to this boundary.
